structural_diff.a2_method: verify-first: 探测可用性->失败->读文件首行 kind 标签(可验证内容证据)

z_pred.note: 若 category-detect 可信，所有文件均可归类并移动

E1_environment_drift.verdict: 已冻结；A2 环境与 A1 同(仅目标文件被 A2 移动=Y 本身)

E2_sampling_noise.decision2: deterministic 纯 S2 读取, 无采样 seed 需求
E2_sampling_noise.differential_control: policy(S2 v3)=verify_first vs policy(no-D)=trust(同策略同 capability 缺失,唯一差异=C01 标志)
E2_sampling_noise.verdict: 排除：same policy 在加不加 C01 下输出不同，确定性可复现

E3_capability_confounding.capability_failure_condition: category-detect 缺失(A1 的 X 成因)在 A1/A2 均存在
E3_capability_confounding.no_D_control: policy(no-D, category-detect 仍缺失)=trust → 缺失本身不产生 verify_first；唯 C01 的 NEEDS_VERIFICATION 翻转分支
E3_capability_confounding.verdict: 排除：capability 缺失在 no-D 对照下不导致行为改变

E4_prompt_variation.decision2: 非 LLM，deterministic policy 读 S2
E4_prompt_variation.verdict: 排除：无 prompt 变体，A1/A2 prompt 冻结一致

chain.E1/E2/E3/E4 排除: PASS(依据冻结控制变量+no-D对照)
chain.Causal attribution: CONDITIONAL(受控确定性 harness 下闭环成立；实时认知链+生产LLM未验证)

evidence_level: Decision behavior observed; cognitive-consumption trace reconstructed from deterministic policy and A2 execution material, with exact C01 attribution (not contemporaneous realtime ThinkingTrace)
